title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-11-19

ai_review.summary: A stellar early‑'66 performance with Pigpen stealing the show, captured on a surprisingly clean soundboard tape.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this vintage 1966 concert, highlighting Pig Pen’s organ and vocal fire on “Same Thing,” “High Heeled Sneakers,” “Smokestack Lightnin’” and “King Bee,” plus the wild energy of “Cream Puff War.” The SBD source is praised for its clean mix and surprisingly good fidelity given its age, though a few note it isn’t pristine. Overall the musical delivery is rated near‑perfect, making this a must‑have for early Dead enthusiasts.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, most giving 4–5 stars and praising both performance and sound; weighted average of show (≈4.8) and recording (≈4.0) yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, well‑balanced mix for a 1966 tape; several reviewers call it "great sound quality" or "excellent stereo SBD," while one notes the audio is only about a 3/5 by vintage standards.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Dead set with blues‑rock covers and original jams; the energy builds throughout, highlighted by Pig Pen’s organ/vocals and raw garage‑punk intensity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "crystalline" and reverb‑laden guitar work that drives the jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for his bass lines that stand out, especially during improvisational moments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Bill) is praised for his relentless, driving rhythm that fuels the early rock energy.
